name: Ar’tor Torn-heart
shortDescription: Oronok’s son, found dead at Illidari Point and encountered later as a spirit.
body: Oronok’s son, found dead at Illidari Point and encountered later as a spirit. Visual details are original generated research art, not canonical model evidence. Composition, markings, costume and exact game resemblance await human comparison with the target Burning Crusade client.
